arxiv-2207-08532.title: Towards a minimal example of quantum nonlocality without inputs
arxiv-2207-08532.creator: Sadra Boreiri, Antoine Girardin, Bora Ulu, Patryk Lipka-Bartosik, Nicolas Brunner, Pavel Sekatski
arxiv-2207-08532.description: Abstract The network scenario offers interesting new perspectives on the phenomenon of quantum nonlocality. Notably, when considering networks with independent sources, it is possible to demonstrate quantum nonlocality without the need for measurements inputs, i.e. with all parties performing a fixed quantum measurement. Here we aim to find minimal examples of this effect.

arxiv-2411-17294.title: Numerical simulation of dilute polymeric fluids with memory effects in the turbulent flow regime
arxiv-2411-17294.creator: Jonas Beddrich, Stephan B. Lunowa, Barbara Wohlmuth
arxiv-2411-17294.description: Abstract We address the numerical challenge of solving the Hookean-type time-fractional Navier–Stokes–Fokker–Planck equation, a history-dependent system of PDEs defined on the Cartesian product of two d d -dimensional spaces in the turbulent regime. Due to its high dimensionality, the non-locality with respect to time, and the resolution required to resolve turbulent flow, this problem is highly demanding.

arxiv-2502-18728.title: Scaling Optimization over Uncertainty via Compilation DOI: 10.1145/3720500 Journal: PACMPL Volume: 9 OOPSLA1 135 4 CCS: Mathematics of computing Probabilistic inference problems CCS: Mathematics of computing Decision diagrams
arxiv-2502-18728.creator: Minsung Cho, John Gouwar, Steven Holtzen
arxiv-2502-18728.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Minsung Cho, John Gouwar, Steven Holtzen. Probabilistic inference is fundamentally hard, yet many tasks require optimization on top of inference, which is even harder. We present a new optimization-via-compilation strategy to scalably solve a certain class of such problems. In particular, we introduce a new intermediate representation (IR), binary decision diagrams weighted by a novel notion of branch-and-bound semiring , that enables a scalable branch-and-bound based optimization procedure.

arxiv-2504-10407.title: Enhancing DESI DR1 Full-Shape analyses using HOD-informed priors
arxiv-2504-10407.creator: H. Zhang, M. Bonici, A. Rocher, W. J. Percival, A. de Mattia, J. Aguilar, S. Ahlen, O. Alves, A. Aviles, A. Baleato Lizancos, D. Bianchi, D. Brooks, A. Cuceu, A. de la Macorra, P. Doel, S. Ferraro, N. Findlay, A. Font-Ribera, D. Forero-Sánchez, J. E. Forero-Romero, S. Gontcho A Gontcho, G. Gutierrez
arxiv-2504-10407.description: Abstract We present an analysis of DESI Data Release 1 (DR1) that incorporates Halo Occupation Distribution (HOD)-informed priors into Full-Shape (FS) modeling of the power spectrum based on cosmological perturbation theory (PT). By leveraging physical insights from the galaxy–halo connection, these HOD-informed priors on nuisance parameters substantially mitigate projection effects in extended cosmological models that allow for dynamical dark energy.

arxiv-2509-01325.title: Robustness to noise and erasures of Gabor frames in finite dimensions
arxiv-2509-01325.creator: Palina Salanevich Nigel Q. D. Strachan
arxiv-2509-01325.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the robustness of structured frames to measurement noise and erasures, with the focus on Gabor frames ( g , Λ ) (g,\Lambda) with arbitrary sets of time-frequency shifts Λ \Lambda . This property of frames is important in many signal processing applications, from wireless communication to phase retrieval and quantization.

arxiv-2602-07125.title: Reasoning-Augmented Representations for Multimodal Retrieval
arxiv-2602-07125.creator: Jianrui Zhang, Anirudh Sundara Rajan, Brandon Han, Soochahn Lee, Sukanta Ganguly, Yong Jae Lee
arxiv-2602-07125.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jianrui Zhang, Anirudh Sundara Rajan, Brandon Han, Soochahn Lee, Sukanta Ganguly, Yong Jae Lee. Universal Multimodal Retrieval (UMR) seeks any-to-any search across text and vision, yet modern embedding models remain brittle when queries require latent reasoning (e.g., resolving underspecified references or matching compositional constraints). We argue this brittleness is often data-induced : when images carry “silent” evidence and queries leave key semantics implicit, a single embedding pass must both reason and compress, encouraging spurious feature matching.

pmc-10601136.creator: Huibian Zhang, Min Gao, Wenying Zhao, Lin Yu
pmc-10601136.description: BackgroundSND1 participates in tumorigenesis, tumour invasion and metastasis in different cancers. Previous studies have shown that SND1 can promote the invasion and migration of breast cancer cells. Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is a specific breast cancer subtype with high metastatic potential and poor prognosis. pmc-11527855.title: Simple and Cost-Effective Generation of 3D Cell Sheets and Spheroids Using Curvature-Controlled Paraffin Wax Substrates
pmc-11527855.creator: Huijung Kim, Kyeong-Mo Koo, Chang-Dae Kim, Min Ji Byun, Chun Gwon Park, Hyungbin Son, Hyung-Ryong Kim, Tae-Hyung Kim
pmc-11527855.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The challenges associated with animal testing in pharmaceutical development have driven the search for alternative in vitro models that mimic human tissues more accurately. In this study, we present a simple and cost-effective method for generating 3D cell sheets and spheroids using curvature-controlled paraffin wax films, which are easily accessible laboratory materials that eliminate the need for extracellular matrix (ECM) components or thermo-responsive polymers.

pmc-11538792.title: Targeted Deletion of Fibroblast Growth Factor 23 Rescues Metabolic Dysregulation of Diet-induced Obesity in Female Mice
pmc-11538792.creator: Min Young Park, Chia-Ling Tu, Luce Perie, Narendra Verma, Tamires Duarte Afonso Serdan, Farnaz Shamsi, Sue Shapses, Sean Heffron, Begona Gamallo-Lana, Adam C Mar, José O Alemán, Elisabetta Mueller, Wenhan Chang, Despina Sitara
pmc-11538792.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23) is a bone-secreted protein widely recognized as a critical regulator of skeletal and mineral metabolism. However, little is known about the nonskeletal production of FGF23 and its role in tissues other than bone. Growing evidence indicates that circulating FGF23 levels rise with a high-fat diet (HFD) and they are positively correlated with body mass index (BMI) in humans.

pmc-12598854.title: Energy Landscape and Kinetic Analysis of Molecular Dynamics Simulations for Intrinsically Disordered Proteins
pmc-12598854.creator: Moritz Schäffler, David J. Wales, Birgit Strodel
pmc-12598854.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Understanding the conformational dynamics of biomolecules requires methods that go beyond structural sampling and provide a quantitative description of thermodynamics and kinetics. For intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs), energy landscape characterization is particularly crucial to unravel their complex conformational behavior. Here, we present a comprehensive protocol for analyzing molecular dynamics (MD) simulations in terms of energy landscapes, metastable states, and transition pathways. Our approach is based on the distribution of reciprocal interatomic distances (DRID) for dimensionality reduction, followed by clustering and kinetic modeling.

pmc-13685351.title: Addressing the challenges of including older people with osteoarthritis and multi-morbidity in digitally enabled trials: a mixed methods Study Within a Project (TIPTOE SWAP)
pmc-13685351.creator: Victoria Shepherd, Hayley Prout, Kate Button, Lucy Brookes-Howells, Elizabeth Randell, Rachel Lowe, Sarah Nash, Rachel Deere, Monica Busse
pmc-13685351.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionOlder adults, particularly those with multiple long-term conditions (MLTCs) and other intersectional characteristics, are under-represented in clinical trials. This includes digitally enabled trials as older people may be less likely to engage with digital methods.We embedded a ‘Study Within a Project’ (SWAP) in TIPTOE, a UK randomised controlled trial evaluating a self-management support intervention for older adults with knee and/or hip osteoarthritis and MLTCs. Osteoarthritis is a musculoskeletal condition that is more common with age.

uslaw-usc-t30-s263.title: 30 U.S.C. § 263 — Permits to use or lease of nonmineral lands for camp sites, and other purposes; annual rentals; acreage
uslaw-usc-t30-s263.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t30-s263.description: United States Code, Title 30 (Mineral Lands And Mining); Chapter 3A (Leases And Prospecting Permits); Subchapter VII (Sodium). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In addition to areas of such mineral land which may be included in any such prospecting permits or leases, the Secretary of the Interior, in his discretion, may grant to a permittee or lessee of lands containing sodium deposits.
